findings.subject: Mega-Mewtu X
findings.detail: Two distinct pink-violet tail tips/stems are visible behind the left shoulder, including a detached upper tip. The exact source has one continuous tail with one tip. An added red area around the blue eye is a secondary source drift.

findings.subject: Mega-Latios
findings.detail: The source has one small white-outlined triangle near the wing root and a plain long upper wing. The output retains a small mark and adds a second large marked upper wing. The consumed source-trait description incorrectly located the marking on the long upper wing. Root and independent reviewer confirmed this by directly re-viewing the exact source, prepared reference and card.

All three figures are larger/higher than the shared spatial reference and numeric prompt bounds. No image-specific size exception has been approved for P15. The physical card silhouettes are contained but several contours are close to edges; this is not a claim that intended size bounds passed.
